title: 第0013章青鳞醒魂第0014章赤米血饲
content_zh:
第0013章青鳞醒魂东南区，凌晨一点。
老式居民楼像沉睡的巨兽，楼道灯忽明忽暗，墙皮剥落，空气里弥漫着潮湿和陈年油烟的味道。巴刀鱼三人潜入目标单元——302室，那个喝下“饲”的老人就住这里。
门虚掩着。
推门，一股浓烈的“香”扑面而来——不是食物的香气，是**死香**，甜腻到发腥，像腐烂的花。
客厅里，老人坐在桌前，面前摆着空汤盒，他双手捧着头，身体微微抽搐，嘴里发出“咕噜咕噜”的吞咽声，可嘴里什么都没有。
“魂被勾了。”娃娃鱼闭眼，“‘饲’在吃他的记忆，尤其是——关于家人的。”
她指向墙上的全家福：老人、妻子、儿子、儿媳。照片被剪掉了一角——儿子的脸不见了。
“他在逃避。”娃娃鱼轻声道，“儿子早年车祸去世，他不敢想。‘饲’就钻这个空子，用虚假的满足填他，让他永远沉在麻木里。”
“那就让他醒。”巴刀鱼走到灶前，打开冰箱。
里面塞满了“速食浓汤”，品牌各异，包装精美，可他一眼看出——全是“食魇”旗下产品。标签角落，藏着极小的符号：锅中无火，只有一滴泪。
“他们在全城下饵。”酸菜汤冷笑，“专挑有伤的人下手。”
巴刀鱼取出一盒，撕开。
汤色乳白，香气诱人，可汤面浮着一层极细的黑丝，像活物般蠕动。
他掌心金纹一动，金焰骨在玉匣中微震。
“就是它。”他低语，“‘青鳞醒魂’的引子，就在这汤里。”
“什么？！”酸菜汤惊，“你要用‘饲’炼菜？你疯了？！”
“不。”巴刀鱼摇头，“我用‘饲’里的‘魂’。这汤，吃了太多人的记忆。它本身，就是一条‘魂之河’。我要从中，钓出‘青鳞鱼’。”
“青鳞鱼？”娃娃鱼问。
“上古主厨的灵材。”巴刀鱼将汤倒入紫砂锅，“生于忘川，游于记忆之河，鳞片能映人心最深的执念。找到它，就能唤醒沉沦的魂。”
他点火。

金焰骨入汤。
刹那——
汤中黑丝疯狂扭动，化作无数张人脸，嘶吼着扑向巴刀鱼！
“净味·破！”他掌心银光注入，金火炸开，人脸尽碎。
可汤未停。
反而沸腾，化作一片**黑水之海**，海中浮现出无数记忆碎片——
一个孩子在哭，母亲抱着他：“不怕，妈妈在。”
一对恋人争吵：“你永远不懂我！”
一个男人跪在墓前：“爸，我混出来了……”
全是**痛苦的记忆**，全是**未说出口的话**。
“它在用记忆攻击你！”娃娃鱼惊呼，“快停！”
“不能停。”巴刀鱼咬牙，命火注入金焰，“‘青鳞’只现于最深的执念。我得沉进去。”
他闭眼，心神沉入黑水之海。
**幻境·记忆之渊**
巴刀鱼站在一片无边的黑海上。脚下是流动的记忆，头顶是扭曲的星空。他看见无数“灯笼”漂浮——那是食客的魂。
content_en:
Chapter 0013 Qinglin Awakening Soul Southeast District, one o'clock in the morning.
The old-fashioned residential buildings are like sleeping giants. The lights in the corridors flicker on and off, the walls peel off, and the air is filled with the smell of humidity and old oil smoke. The three of them sneaked into the target unit, Room 302, where the old man who drank "Fe" lived.
The door was ajar.
When I opened the door, a strong "fragrance" hit my face - not the aroma of food, but the smell of death, so sweet that it was fishy, ​​like rotten flowers.
In the living room, the old man sat at the table with an empty soup box in front of him. He held his head in his hands, his body twitched slightly, and he made a "gurgling" swallowing sound, but there was nothing in his mouth.
"The soul has been hooked." Baby Fish closed his eyes, "'Fei' is eating his memories, especially - about his family."
She pointed to the family portrait on the wall: old man, wife, son, daughter-in-law. A corner of the photo was cropped - the son's face was missing.
"He is escaping." Baoyu said softly, "He did not dare to think about his son's death in a car accident early in his life. 'Fe' took advantage of this loophole and filled him with false satisfaction, making him sink into numbness forever."
"Then let him wake up." Baliyu walked to the stove and opened the refrigerator.
It was filled with "instant soup" of different brands and beautifully packaged, but he could tell at a glance that they were all products of "Shi Ni". In the corner of the label, there is a tiny symbol: There is no fire in the pot, only a tear.
"They are setting bait all over the city." Sauerkraut Tang sneered, "They only pick out the injured people."
Baliyu took out a box and tore it open.
The soup is milky white in color and has an attractive aroma, but there is a layer of extremely fine black threads floating on the surface of the soup, squirming like a living creature.
The golden pattern on his palm moved, and the golden flame bones shook slightly in the jade box.
"That's it." He whispered, "The introduction to 'Green Scales Awakening Soul' is in this soup."
"What?!" Sauerkraut Tang was shocked, "You want to use 'feed' to make vegetables? Are you crazy?!"
"No." Basio fish shook his head, "I use the 'soul' in the 'feed'. This soup has eaten up too many people's memories. It itself is a 'river of souls'. I want to fish out the 'blue-scaled fish' from it."
"Blue-scaled fish?" the giant salamander asked.
"The spiritual material of ancient chefs." Baoyu poured the soup into the purple clay pot. "Born in the River of Forgetfulness, swimming in the river of memory, the scales can reflect the deepest obsessions of the human heart. If you find it, you can awaken the sunken soul."
He lit a fire.
The golden flame bones are put into the soup.
A moment——
The black threads in the soup twisted wildly and turned into countless human faces, roaring and rushing towards the bass fish!
"Pure flavor, broken!" Silver light poured into his palm, golden fire exploded, and the human face was shattered.
But the soup didn't stop.
Instead, it boiled and turned into a **sea of black water**, with countless memory fragments emerging from the sea——
A child is crying, and his mother is holding him: "Don't be afraid, mom is here."
A pair of lovers quarrel: "You will never understand me!"
A man knelt in front of the tomb: "Dad, I got out..."
All **painful memories**, all **unspoken words**.
"It's attacking you with its memory!" The giant salamander exclaimed, "Stop!"
"It can't stop." The swordfish gritted its teeth and injected the life fire into the golden flame. "The 'green scale' only appears in the deepest obsession. I have to sink in."
He closed his eyes and his mind sank into the sea of black water.
**Illusion·Abyss of Memory**
Baldfish stands on a boundless black sea. There are flowing memories under your feet, and the twisted starry sky above your head. He saw countless "lanterns" floating - they were the souls of diners.
